name: JGO
description: Self-hosted web player for Java ME (J2ME) games. KEmulator nnmod runs the JAR on the server and streams the picture, sound and input to any browser. Native install, no Docker.

notes.text: The access token is printed at the end of the install; show it again with `jgo token` inside the container.
Keep the container on a private network. Do not forward port 8080 to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy and extra access control.
Games run as the unprivileged user jgo, without network access, with memory/CPU limits. Needs the container feature nesting (the default).
